name: Senir's Report
summary: In the cold foothills of Dun Morogh, Senir Whitebeard sends word of the Frostmane trolls to Ironforge. His report carries findings gathered under King Magni Bronzebeard’s directive for Senator Barin Redstone.

sections.title: A Royal Directive
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard’s report gathers mountaineer observations from scouting against Frostmane trolls in Dun Morogh’s crags. Stationed in the cold foothills, Senir includes his brother Grelin’s account of Coldridge Valley, where Grelin acted under King Magni Bronzebeard’s sanction. Senir sends the findings to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge’s High Seat and advises couriers to leave out how much outside help he needed to compile them.

sections.title: Friction in the High Seat
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard’s account reaches the royal court and stirs an uproar. Senator Barin Redstone is angered by the troll threat and by the authority stamped on the report. Magni bypassed legislative oversight, while Whitebeard acted on unchecked royal orders. The move deepens resentment among senators who demand control over procedure, sharpening the strain between Magni’s decisive rule and the Senate’s claims to authority.

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard’s report records his investigations into the Frostmane trolls in Dun Morogh. He sends it to the dwarven Senate in Ironforge.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the report?
aliases: who do i give the report to
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard addresses the report to Senator Barin Redstone in the High Seat of Ironforge, near King Magni Bronzebeard’s throne.

faq.q: Why does Senator Redstone get so angry when he reads it?
faq.answer: Senator Redstone is furious because Grelin Whitebeard’s enclosed report says Grelin acted under King Magni’s authority without consulting the Senate. Redstone resents the crown taking unilateral action on defense matters without senatorial approval.

faq.q: Why does Senir ask you not to mention helping him?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard asks you to keep your help quiet so his superiors will believe he handled the hazardous scouting in the snowy hills alone. He wants to protect his reputation as a diligent, capable mountaineer.

angles.text: As a dwarf, carrying Senir’s Report brings you into Ironforge’s divide between King Magni Bronzebeard’s decrees and the authority the Senate demands.
As an Alliance member, carrying Senir’s Report helps defend Dun Morogh while you navigate the prickly politics of Ironforge’s rulers.
